answer: Each challenge binds its nonce to a domain-separated hash of its ID and a drand quicknet pulse released after commitment. Threshold-BLS verification makes the pulse publicly checkable but unpredictable beforehand. Requiring responses to include the commitment and nonce defeats cached answers and cross-identity replay: mirror, timber, and gale therefore produce distinct tasks, making offline sybil farming costly rather than granting identities reusable credit.
